description:
src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) has no production consumer. Every causal:: reference outside the module is either inside a #[cfg(test)] mod (pull.rs, whose mod tests opens at 2559) or in an already-gated module (public_trace.rs). No binary uses it.

It is deliberately published -- src/lib.rs:29 does 'pub use telemetry::causal' -- so this is an intentionally exported analysis library that nothing ships against, not an accident.

It cannot simply be gated: tests/fz2_cli.rs consumes it as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test), the same constraint that drove fz-foq.1.

## Blocked by fz-0am, and mostly dissolved by it

The earlier framing of this ticket -- 'extract 1960 lines to a dev-dependency crate, or declare trace analysis unshipped production' -- assumed the module keeps its current shape. fz-0am removes roughly 275-300 lines of inference and turns the rest into tallies over emitted events. Decide how much should EXIST before deciding where it lives.

## What is left to decide afterwards

Whatever survives is a stream reader: parse JSONL, translate raw ids through the log's own canon lines, tally. Then the same two answers apply to a much smaller thing:

A. Test support -- extract to a dev-dependency crate as fz-foq.1 did. Coupling to the lib is one enum (handler::EventKind, 6 uses), so it is feasible; cargo permits the cycle through the dev-dependency edge.
B. Unshipped production -- the CLI writes traces (fz2 --log-telemetry) but ships nothing that reads one. If fz2 should interpret its own trace, causal belongs in the lib and the gap is the missing subcommand.

Do not pick A by default because it makes a lint quiet.

comments.text:
Investigated: the filed plan does not work, and the real finding is larger.

Why 'move the 3 helpers into tests/fz2_cli.rs' fails:
- functions() is on CanonTables and reads the PRIVATE field self.functions (causal.rs:122). Moving it out would require making that field pub -- a wider surface than the one being removed.
- formula_totals/product_totals are not fz2_cli-only. src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs calls them at 10+ sites. Moving them into fz2_cli.rs would duplicate them, not relocate them.

The real finding: src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) has ZERO production consumers.
- pull.rs's three causal:: references are all inside its #[cfg(test)] mod tests (opens at 2559).
- public_trace.rs is itself a #[cfg(test)]-gated module.
- No CLI or binary use.

It cannot simply be gated, because tests/fz2_cli.rs consumes it as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test) -- the same constraint that drove fz-foq.1.

Its only coupling to the lib is `use super::handler::EventKind` (6 occurrences of a plain enum), so a fz-foq.1-style extraction to a dev-dependency crate is feasible; the crate would depend on fz for EventKind, which cargo permits because the fz -> crate edge is a dev-dependency.

Needs a decision before proceeding -- see the rewritten description.

Blocked by fz-0am. Before deciding where causal analysis should live, decide how much of it should exist: ~669 lines of Replay reconstruct a link the scheduler holds at enqueue time. Answering fz-0am changes what is left to house.

title: Rehome or retire what remains of causal after fz-0am
